name: Historic Cairo
description: Historic Cairo is the old heart of Egypt's capital, a dense maze of lanes where hundreds of mosques, madrasas, tombs, bathhouses and merchant inns have stood since the 10th century. Domes and minarets crowd the skyline around the Citadel and the walled medieval city. Its Coptic quarter reaches back even further, to Roman times, so a single walk can cross many centuries.
